comment: Read from src/Dobbs.cpp at commit 71e0bcb, the last commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.30. The Trig/Gate jack has no threshold of its own: Dobbs.cpp:302 hands the raw voltage to a BooleanTrigger, so any value that is not exactly zero counts as high and a negative voltage fires the envelope as readily as a positive one. Only the sustain test uses a real threshold, 0.5V. The two Fast buttons are unlabelled apart from the word Fast beside each; their hover texts read TimeScale 1 and TimeScale 2. The AR/ASR button is one per half and reaches both envelopes of that half, as does the Shape knob. The README calls the delayed envelope a twin Peak with its own attack and decay, which is right, but the Shape knob and the AR/ASR mode are shared rather than separate. The panel-theme submenu is plugin-wide and cosmetic, so it has no line.
